title: Alvaro A NDE 5039
content: Guadalupe, Zacatecas, México, January 13, 2011. Hi! I'm Alvaro A, I'm a man that has an unusual experience I'm forty-nine years old and live in Guadalupe, Zacatecas, México now. When I was eighteen years old, I was living in Zacatecas city in the state of the same name in México. My father put a business near to home and let to me take care of this. I hated this job, because I was so young and I wanted to have a good time. Well, near of late spring or early summer of the 1979, I wanted to go run around in the street with some friends. I exited the door of the business and I jumped for a big step. I leaned on my left hand and I heard a crack of my bones of my hand. The pain was unbearable, and I went with my mother who was in the kitchen of our home. At this time, my older brother arrived, took my hand, and squeezed it, thinking it was a simple injury. At that, I felt like my whole body tingled and I start to come staggering to a very dark tunnel, I felt so light, without my body. At the bottom of the tunnel, I saw a so bright light and at once, I stopped in kind of portal, I walked into this way. I felt so nice, without preoccupation, hungry, sleep, pain or other feeling. I know that there is a 'presence' of somebody at my right side. I didn't see anybody. I started walking, and watched to my left a kind of long stone wall with barred windows, full of people, they screamed 'Help me!' but their mouths don't open, I listened more. I asked the presence, 'Who are they?' and 'he' replied 'Not yet.' I continued straight ahead and saw a huge and beautiful garden full of people dressed in white, who were turning to see a sort of a stoned wall, from which there was a blinding light. This wall had some closed doors. One more time I asked: 'Who are they?' and the same answer: 'Not yet.' We continued walking toward the front of one of the doors and saw light through the cracks in them. We stopped at the door and I asked, 'What's behind?' and the same answer: 'Not yet.' At that time, began the return, at the same breakneck speed that I left my body. I felt the entrance in this. I saw my older brother concerned, telling me: 'You got purple, you fell, not breathing, and I gave resuscitation to you for about two minutes.' We went to the hospital; they took an x-ray, which had the bone of the middle finger on the palm of left hand broken. It was immobilized in a cast and healed. But the success, it was not a dream. I in reality felt it. I hope that I have expressed my own experience to you.

arrival.other_being_detail: A 'presence' at his right side that he did not see; it replied 'Not yet.'

environment.environment_other_detail: Long stone wall with barred windows full of people; later a huge beautiful garden with people dressed in white; a stone wall with closed doors and a blinding light behind it.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Hand injury (broken bone) followed by collapse and not breathing; brother performed resuscitation about two minutes.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Encountered crowds behind barred windows pleading for help, then a garden with people in white and doors in a wall with blinding light behind.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: People behind barred windows in a long stone wall, screaming 'Help me!' but with mouths not opening; repeated response from the presence: 'Not yet.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Help me!” / “Not yet.” / “You got purple, you fell, not breathing, and I gave resuscitation to you for about two minutes.”
